content.title: CSK vs PBKS Live Score, IPL 2026: Shreyas and Priyansh help PBKS ace 210 chase
content.text: PBKS won by 5 wickets (with 8 balls remaining)Apr 3, 2026, 12:58 PMPBKS winPunjab Kings 210 for 5 (Shreyas 50, Priyansh 39, Kamboj 2-43) beat Chennai Super Kings 209 for 5 (Mhatre 73, Dube 45, Vyshak 2-38) by five wicketsPunjab are the Kings of 200-plus chases in the IPL. They'd done it eight times and they did it again on Friday night as Priyansh Arya and Shreyas Iyer laid waste to the Chennai Super Kings bowling attack. Arya had 33 off 9 when the PBKS fifty came up. Shreyas was 4 off 5 before accelerating to a 26-ball fifty.Chennai Super Kings are now winless after two games and what will worry them is that they were outplayed in conditions that enhance their strength. They have a strong top five. Pitches like this one that allow them to hit through the line makes them stronger. But the 209 for 5 they put up didn't cover for the weakness in their bowling.Apr 3, 2026, 12:52 PMShreyas fifty and outShreyas was 4 off 5 not so long ago. Now he is 50 off 26. It's been a very cool innings from the PBKS captain. He didn't allow himself to feel any pressure. A lot of batters will feel the same way he does when they face CSK. Maybe Noor Ahmed's left-arm wristspin would give oppositions pause. Or maybe they'll think they can still start out taking risks against him and then reassess if bad things happen because backing up whatever wickets Noor or anybody else takes for that matter appears to be an issue for CSK.That said, CSK have taken two wickets in two balls, Shreyas gone for 50, Wadhera gone for a duck.Apr 3, 2026, 12:27 PMShreyas nails ChaharThe 13th over started with PBKS' chances of victory at 45% because Connolly had fallen in the previous over. It ended with PBKS' chances of victory at 65% because Shreyas Iyer has made his move.Apr 3, 2026, 12:20 PMConnolly gone He doesn't have the power to clear the fielder at mid-off off a full toss. He'll be kicking himself all the way back to the dressing room. PBKS need 83 in 49 balls. They have Shreyas and Nehal Wadhera in the middle.CSK have one over of spin from Noor and two from Chahar. Then they'll have to trust the quicks to do the job, except the quicks have been pretty easy to hit all day.Apr 3, 2026, 12:05 PMPrabhsimran goneAnd it's a waste of wicket. Run-out trying for a two when there was no two. Shreyas Iyer has walked to the middle. Well, strutted really. The guy is virtually confidence on two legs.CSK, thanks to their preference for experience, used to be a bit of a dud fielding team. That seems to have changed now. Noor, the bowler, hared across for the ball which had wandered into the vacant midwicket region. Sarfaraz had also come in from the deep and backed him up. It was Sarfaraz who threw the ball to the non-strikers' end after Connolly sent Prabhsimran backApr 3, 2026, 12:04 PMConnolly hype The wider world hasn't woken up to him but maybe this IPL will help.After winning a game practically on his own, Cooper Connolly has walked out here and taken on Noor Ahmed's left-arm wrist spin. It looks like his game has everything except how to take a backwards step.CSK are trying to put their usual spin choke in. Their batting doing well in the first innings allowed them the liberty of bringing in Rahul Chahar as their impact sub, instead of Jamie Overton.Connolly's performance today might go a long way in terms of disrupting CSK's spin plans and upholding PBKS' batting plansApr 3, 2026, 11:43 AMArya goneIn the old days, once you get a start, if you don't convert it, it would be called a crime.Now, an innings like Arya's played, 39 off 11 at a strike rate of 355, will be shown as the example of what T20 openers need to do. He saw 200-plus on the board. He knew breaking the back of the chase will require heavy carnage in the powerplay. He also knew his team has a long batting line-up. So it doesn't matter if he's not out there scoring the winning runs. It's enough if he sets his mates up.Arya has done that. ESPNcricinfo's forecaster says PBKS' chances of winning are already up at 42%.Apr 3, 2026, 11:36 AMAyra's riseEight balls faced, five boundaries hit.At the pre-match press conference, PBKS assistant coach Brad Haddin said watching Arya bat had the coaches going wow. He was very raw in his first year, the last year, but his hand speed was just so good.What impressed Haddin is when the team reconvened for this season, Arya had developed his game, he had become a better player than he was in IPL 2025.PBKS have brought up their 50 in 3.2 overs. Arya is 27 off 8 balls with three fours and two sixes.Apr 3, 2026, 11:18 AMImpact Player Arya arrivesAfter being subbed in for Chahal, Arya kicks off PBKS' chase with a brace of boundaries. When Khaleel Ahmed goes full in search of swing, Arya bashes him straight past him for four. Next ball is shorter and at the body, but Arya was right back for this, swatting him over midwicket for the first six of the innings.Khaleel has got the outswinger going against the right-handed Prabhsimran, and even beats his outside edge, but ends up conceding 14 off the first over.The ball isn't swinging for Matt Henry for the second over, and Arya cracks 4,6,4 against him to speed away to 25 off 6 balls.Apr 3, 2026, 11:05 AMCSK 209 for 5CSK finish with on 209 for 5 the back of Ayush Mhatre's 73 off 43 and Sarfaraz Khan's delightful cameo. He made 32 off 12 ramping bouncers that the bowler thought he'd got away with for six and yorkers that the bowler thought he'd got away with for four. PBKS have a long and dangerous batting line-up and they have history of chasing down tall totals2024 The last time CSK crossed 200 at home in the IPL. They've now made 15 200-plus totals at Chepauk, the last of which happened against SRH in April 2024Apr 3, 2026, 10:50 AMVeer's entryPrashant Veer on IPL debut.First ball, from Bartlett, bouncer, too good, no shot offeredSecond ball, from Bartlett, bouncer again, chases it, gets beatenThird ball, from Jansen, shuffles across to to scoop it for four.CSK have long been suspicious of young players and their ability to cope with the pressure of the IPL. The last season showed them they had to come off that high horse. The injuries in the lead up to this season has opened up spots for 19-year-old Kartik Sharma and 20-year-old Veer in the XI itself. It's their time now. Let's see if they take their chance.Apr 3, 2026, 10:38 AMSarfaraz's start6 boundaries for Sarfaraz Khan by the time he'd faced 10 balls against PBKSHe falls to the 12th ball he faces though, but by that time, he'd collected 32 runs at a strike rate of 266. Shivam Dube at the other end is 14 off 14. So that should provide some context of how good Sarfarz's innings was.Vyshak gets the wicket in the 17th over.Dube was being kept quiet by yorkers. Sarfaraz was hitting them to the deep third boundary with cheeky little dabs of his open faced bat. Dube felt the need to actually go up and offer Sarfaraz a word or or two as he walked off.Apr 3, 2026, 10:31 AMSarfaraz entrySarfaraz Khan has just played two glorious shots to the third man boundary off Arshdeep Singh in the 15th over.The first one had him arching his back, away from a bouncer, and it almost looks like he had left it until he popped his bat up and the ball just bounced off it over the keeper.The next shot was even better. Arshdeep hit a hard length, without going bouncer, and the pitch responded, giving him extra bounce. Sarfaraz was recoiling from the ball as he dabbed it with an open face and somehow he picks the gap between the keeper and a very fine short thirdIn a CSK line-up that needs a little something down the order, Sarfaraz, a domestic stalwart, is providing it. He's got the shots - especially the unorthodox ones, and the game against spin to do well.Apr 3, 2026, 10:24 AMThe PBKS fightbackThis is what's happened between the 12th and 14th overs.PBKS have a loooong and power-packed batting line-up. No total will be beyond them, but it looks like they're already dragging that total down.Apr 3, 2026, 10:11 AMVoteWho is the best teenager in the IPL?618 votesMhatre is gone. At the point of his dismissal, he had scored 73 of CSK's 123 runs. That's nearly 60%. The other end had scored 38 off 32 balls. There were 12 extras.Apr 3, 2026, 10:05 AMDube arrivesThe world cup winner gets a huge ovation at Chepauk. "Du-be! Du-be! Du-be!" they chant as Chahal runs in to bowl at, well, Dube.Gaikwad had to make way for him, falling for 28 off 22. It felt like he had to either hit out or get out, given the nature of the pitch and the relative strength of the CSK bowling attack. They're going to need par-plus here to be able to defendApr 3, 2026, 10:03 AMMhatre on song10.2 - Vyshak nails a wide yorker. Mhatre can only dab it into the off side for a run10.5 - Vyshak goes for the wide yorker again. Mhatre is able to steer it to the right of short third and backward point and time it well enough to beat deep point to this left.Class batting. He found a solve for a ball that the bowler thought was a banker in such a short time.Apr 3, 2026, 9:49 AMMhatre fiftyForty of his runs have come in boundaries. And that count keeps rising. Marcus Stoinis gets smashed in the ninth over.Mhatre came into this game with 11 sixes in the IPL. Ten of them had come off pace. He's pushed both those counts by five tonight.A crowd of 30,000 is totally behind him. "CSK! CSK! CSK!" They chantAt the end of nine overs, CSK 94 for 1 Mhatre: 59 off 32 balls, 4x4s, 5x6s Other end: 27 in 22 balls, 3x4sApr 3, 2026, 9:42 AMQuiet Gaikwad8 runs off five balls - Ruturaj Gaikwad's contribution when CSK's second-wicket partnership reached fifty. Ayush Mhatre has scored 37 off 23.Apr 3, 2026, 9:37 AMMhatre vs pace193 Ayush Mhatre's strike rate against pace in the IPL.Makes sense he's 29 off 19, he's only faced pace today with the field up. How will he go now that the powerplay is done and Yuzvendra Chahal will be coming on. Mhatre's strike rate against spin in the IPL is 131.82. He's actually only faced 22 deliveries of spin in the IPL, which perhaps shows that last season he wasn't quite building an innings to carry on past the first six overs.Apr 3, 2026, 9:25 AMMhatre vs BartlettMhatre was dismissed on the pull shot in the first game. In the lead up to this one, Hussey with the whanger kept feeding him short balls and he kept working on the swivel pull. A little bit of that work seems to be paying off early here. The third boundary in the sequence was a confident swivel pull - and Mhatre deserves more credit for it because the first two were full balls that he'd put away over mid-on to engineer that change in length.Apr 3, 2026, 9:19 AMSamson goneAnd the ground goes completely quiet. Big things were expected from their new recruit. Someone who actually has a history of starting IPLs well. This season however Samson has bagged a couple of single-digit scores, revealing a weakness against the moving ball. Xavier Bartlett gets the wicket, an outswinger that takes a thick outside edge through to the keeper. Samson's method of just standing and delivering works so well when the ball is coming onto the bat. But a little bit of sideways movement...PS - if you wanna know a lil bit about Bartlett, this will help.Apr 3, 2026, 9:03 AMTifos at ChepaukWith the players about to make their way onto the field, the fans are unfurling their tifos. One of them has a cartoon lion saying whistle podu. Another says yellove. There's probably a Dhoni tifo that I can't quite see, or they're saving that for the man himself when he is ready to play.The cartoon lion would be very happy. Full, shrill whistles from allll around the ground as Sanju Samson and Ruturaj Gaikwad walk out to the pitch.Who will make the biggest impact today?736 votes6 of the last seven IPL matches between these two teams has been won by Punjab KingsApr 3, 2026, 8:36 AMToss: Punjab bowlChennai Super Kings: 1 Sanju Samson (wk), 2 Ruturaj Gaikwad (capt), 3 Ayush Mhatre, 4 Sarfaraz Khan, 5 Shivam Dube, 6 Kartik Sharma, 7 Prashant Veer, 8 Noor Ahmed, 9 Matt Henry, 10 Anshul Kamboj, 11 Khaleel Ahmed, 12 Jamie Overton/Rahul ChaharPunjab Kings: 1 Prabhsimran Singh (wk), 2 Shreyas Iyer (capt), 3 Cooper Connolly, 4 Shashank Singh, 5 Nehal Wadhera, 6 Marcus Stoinis, 7 Marco Jansen, 8 Xavier Bartlett, 9 Vijaykumar Vyshak, 10 Arshdeep Singh, 11 Yuzvendra Chahal, 12 Priyansh AryaA recent trend of things going Punjab Kings' way at Chepauk continued as Shreyas Iyer won the toss and chose to bowl on a pitch expected to be full of runs. PBKS have won each of the last three games against Chennai Super Kings at this ground. They are going in with an unchanged team, with Priyansh Arya likely to come in as Impact Sub.Chennai Super Kings handed an IPL debut to Prashant Veer, the 20-year-old left-arm spin-bowling allrounder whom they bought for INR 14.2 crore at the auction. He slots in alongside their other INR 14.2 crore buy Kartik Sharma. To make room for Veer, Matt Short has made way. It is unlikely Short would play given CSK are batting first. CSK's XI only has two overseas players. They could bring in Jamie Overton as an impact sub and make it three.MS Dhoni and Dewald Brevis who did attend the CSK nets on the eve of the match remain sidelined with a calf injury and a side injury respectively.Apr 3, 2026, 8:22 AMChepauk check inHello from Chepauk!There is a noticeable drop in the buzz around the ground. Wonder why. Virtually all the crowd is here in a Dhoni shirt. There were a few Samsons around as. Even one Gaikwad and one Shreyas. Last year's finalists have some heavy duty players and the pitch tonight is likely to serve up a 200 vs 200 run-fest. So buckle up.Apr 3, 2026, 7:49 AM'Allow them to make mistakes'Gaikwad wants CSK youngsters to embrace IPL pressure. "Looking at this team now, it is a very young team. The excitement is there but at the same time, there's a lot of difference between experienced players and inexperienced players. So, you have to allow them to make mistakes. You have to allow them to express themselves. You have to make sure that they are in a good headspace," Gaikwad said ahead of the PBKS game. More here.Apr 3, 2026, 6:57 AM'Chetta' Super KingApr 3, 2026, 6:36 AMChahal vs Samson? 23 Yuzvendra Chahal took a hat-trick the last time he played CSK in Chennai. He has 23 wickets against them in IPL matches at an economy rate of 7.1.More crucially, Chahal has the upper hand against their star player. He has dismissed Sanju Samson five times in 12 innings for just 61 runs. No bowler has taken him out as often in the IPL.Apr 3, 2026, 6:04 AMIn the spotlightRuturaj Gaikwad has six single-digit scores in his last ten innings in the IPL. He missed a good chunk of the last season with injury and is starting this one back at the top of the order and with a new partner, whose stature is a threat to his captaincy. Gaikwad said in his conversations with Samson that Samson would prefer Gaikwad to keep leading CSK. But that would depend on the results. Gaikwad has a fine record at Chepauk - 764 runs at an average of 50.9 and a strike-rate of 142.Eleven batters have scored a century against CSK in the IPL. Marcus Stoinis is one of only two to do so at Chepauk. His role, down at No. 6, probably prevents him from going that big, but he should still enjoy a good feeling walking into the ground as he looks to put behind a duck in his first game of the season, against Gujarat Titans.Apr 3, 2026, 5:39 AMTeam news and likely XIIsDewald Brevis is recovering from a side injury, and while he had a long net, he only faced throw downs and barely did more than defending the ball. It seems unlikely he'll be back. Without him, CSK's middle order appears vulnerable again. CSK's IPL opener was their first without MS Dhoni or Suresh Raina in the XI. The one on Friday will be the third time they play at Chepauk without Dhoni.Chennai Super Kings: 1 Sanju Samson (wk), 2 Ruturaj Gaikwad (capt), 3 Ayush Mhatre, 4 Matt Short, 5 Shivam Dube, 6 Sarfaraz Khan/Prashant Veer, 7 Kartik Sharma, 8 Jamie Overton, 9 Noor Ahmed, 10 Matt Henry, 11 Anshul Kamboj, 12 Khaleel Ahmed"No break," said PBKS assistant coach Brad Haddin, when asked about Shreyas' hand, which took a blow while standing at the non-strikers' end in the last game. Ricky Ponting said PBKS had strengthened from the time they finished as IPL finalists last year. Considering the success of Cooper Connolly - and even without it, the mere fact that he was batting at No. 3, displacing Shreyas who had such great success there (360 runs at an average of 51.42 and strike rate of 180.9) - was proof of the good work they had done at the auction table. They have batting down to No. 8, and seven bowling options if Connolly and Marcus Stoinis can bowl.Punjab Kings: 1 Priyansh Arya, 2 Prabhsimran Singh (wk), 3 Cooper Connolly, 4 Shreyas Iyer (capt), 5 Nehal Wadhera, 6 Shashank Singh, 7 Marcus Stoinis, 8 Marco Jansen, 9 Xavier Bartlett, 10 Vijaykumar Vyshak, 11 Arshdeep Singh, 12 Yuzvendra ChahalApr 3, 2026, 4:59 AMCan CSK regain their fortress?CSK can definitely take heart from the conditions in Chennai. They've flattened out, requiring a different kind of batter. Like Sanju Samson, who has hit a six once every eight balls in T20s this year.But Punjab Kings have the same affinity for clearing the boundary. Priyansh Arya and Prabhsimran Singh, who will open the batting, have hit more than half their IPL career sixes in the powerplay. Shreyas Iyer brings the same ruthless efficiency to the middle overs and Shashank Singh was the joint second-highest six-hitter in the death overs in IPL 2025.PBKS are one of four IPL teams with an equal or greater number of wins against CSK in Chennai (P9, W5, L4). They've been on the right side of the result in three successive trips to Chepauk. Last year, CSK's hold of their fortress was shattered (P6, W1, L5). This year, will they get it back?CSKPBKS100%50%100%CSK InningsPBKS InningsOver 19 • PBKS 210/5PBKS won by 5 wickets (with 8 balls remaining)Instant answers to T20 questions
